href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3183">#3183</a>)</li> </ul> <h3 id="release-notes-5">1.3 Release Notes</h3> <h4 id="release-notes-6">1.3 Release Notes</h4> <h5 id="fixed-in-this-release">Fixed In This Release</h5> <ul> <li>Fix incorrect preview behavior when reloading edited pages from listings (e.g. blog posts). Fixes (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/6026">#6026</a>)</li> </ul> <h5 id="fixed-in-previous-releases">Fixed In Previous Releases</h5> <ul> <li>Fix issue that prevented Quarto from properly reporting crossreferenceable figures to IDEs (note that Quarto 1.3.427 contained an attempted fix for this issue which did not work properly. This release contains a functional fix.)</li> <li>Fix incorrect behavior when previewing <code>--to all</code></li> <li>Fix missing handling of <code>rel="..."</code> values in the navbar’s tools template (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/5756">#5756</a>)</li> <li>Disable browser cache using <code>Cache-Control</code> header config in the viewer redirect for PDF preview, correctly allowing a HTML preview later on same port. (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/5882">#5882</a>)</li> <li>Fix error when publishing a document in a subfolder (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto/issues/183">quarto-dev/quarto#183</a>).</li> <li>Fix error when publishing a document in a subfolder (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/5330">#5330</a>).</li> <li>Fix duplicate bibliography when users enable <code>citeproc</code> directly. (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/5588">#5588</a>).</li> <li>Fix issue where specificying <code>search: false</code> on an individual page would not exclude that page from the website search index.</li> <li>Fix error when rendering document with HTML Widgets after updating to Knitr 1.43. (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/5702">#5702</a>).</li> <li>Properly position margin elements (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/5289">#5289</a>).</li> <li>Improve chrome detection for MacOS (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/2214">#2214</a>).</li> <li>Correctly hide section numbers in responsive HTML view of books, when requested (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/5306">#5306</a>).</li> <li>Properly handle figures within lists (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/5317">#5317</a>, <a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/5461">#5461</a>).</li> <li>Do not hide banner style title block when in responsive view (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/5296">#5296</a>).</li> <li>Ensure global environment is available to LUA filters (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/5466">#5466</a>).</li> <li>Ensure RevealJS navigation works properly even when there is a section called ‘Theme’ (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/5455">#5455</a>).</li> </ul> <h5 id="confluence-publishing">Confluence Publishing</h5> <ul> <li>Add support for publishing both documents and projects to Atlassian Confluence spaces and as children to Confluence pages.</li> </ul> <h5 id="jupyter-notebooks-1">Jupyter Notebooks</h5> <ul> <li>Add support for embedding cell outputs in quarto documents using <code>{{< embed >}}</code>. You can address cells by Id, Tag, or label, such as <code>{{< embed mynotebook.ipynb#fig-output >}}</code> which would embed the output of a cell with the label <code>fig-output</code>). You can also provide a list of ids like <code>{{< embed mynotebook.ipynb#fig-output,tbl-out >}}</code>.</li> <li>Only attempt to postprocess <code>text/plain</code> output if it’s nonempty (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3896">#3896</a>).</li> <li>Fix output of bokeh plots so the right number of cells is generated (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/2107">#2107</a>).</li> <li>Fix output of code cells that contain triple backticks (or more) (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3179">#3179</a>).</li> <li>Don’t install SIGCHLD signal handler since it interferes with IJulia in Julia 1.8.4 and greater (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/2539">#2539</a>).</li> <li>Resolve full path to QUARTO_PYTHON binary</li> <li>Improve handling of YAML and titles in notebooks (auto-merge heading based title with YAML front matter)</li> <li>Discard matplotlib, seaborn, and plotnine intermediate objects from output</li> <li>With IJulia’s miniconda python env, search for <code>python</code> in addition to <code>python3</code> (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4821">#4821</a>).</li> <li>Allow <code>export:</code> as a cell yaml option to support new nbdev syntax (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3152">#3152</a>).</li> <li>merge multiple <code>stream</code> outputs to work around diverging behavior between <code>jupyter</code> and <code>nbclient</code> (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4968">#4968</a>).</li> </ul> <h5 id="knitr-engine">Knitr engine</h5> <ul> <li>Help rmarkdown find pandoc binary bundled with Quarto if none is found (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3688">#3688</a>).</li> <li>Do not bind knitr engine when only inline <code>r</code> expressions are found (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3908">#3908</a>).</li> <li>Fix an issue with <code>output: asis</code> in chunks with plots (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3683">#3683</a>).</li> </ul> <h5 id="code-annotation-3">Code Annotation</h5> <ul> <li>Add support for annotation of code cells (executable or non-executable). You can read more about code annotation at <a href="https://www.quarto.org/docs/prerelease/1.3.html">quarto.org</a>.</li> </ul> <h5 id="html-format-2">HTML Format</h5> <ul> <li>Improved handling of margin references that appear within a callout. (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3003">#3003</a>)</li> <li>Add support for customizing the baseline widths of grid columns using yaml or scss. For more information, see <a href="https://www.quarto.org/docs/prerelease/1.3.html">quarto.org</a>.</li> <li>Fix wrapping of long <code>code</code> entries inside table cells (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3221">#3221</a>)</li> <li>Fix author display to use the <code>url</code> for an author even when there is no affiliation.</li> <li>Add support for linking to other formats, when more than one format is produced. Alternate formats will appear with the TOC. Control using <code>format-links</code>.</li> <li>Add support for linking to source notebooks that provide embedded content. Control using <code>notebook-links</code></li> <li>Improve callout wrapping behavior for long strings with no word breaks.</li> <li>Add overflow to tables generated from SQL code cells (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3497">#3497</a>).</li> <li>Fix support for parquet files in OJS code cells (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3630">#3630</a>).</li> <li>Forward bootstrap table classes from caption to table element (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4036">#4036</a>).</li> <li>Render code listings with names and captions correctly (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/2195">#2195</a>).</li> <li>Fix issue with interactivity of elements in mobile size dispay when <code>toc-left</code> is being used. (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4244">#4244</a>).</li> <li>Allow control of the ‘cite as’ appendix in HTML documents using <code>appendix-cite-as</code> (pass <code>false</code>, <code>display</code>, or <code>bibtex</code>). (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/2625">#2625</a>)</li> <li>Properly anchor custom appendix sections (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3112">#3112</a>).</li> <li>Don’t display custom appendix sections in the TOC (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3113">#3113</a>).</li> <li>Use custom <code>styles.html</code> template partial to better support checkbox alignment (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4556">#4556</a>).</li> <li>Improve ergonomics of text-highting in HTML output, not emitting difficult overwrite styles and better supporting theme -> CSS conversion. (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4334">#4334</a>).</li> <li>Improve CSS of nested tight and loose lists (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/discussions/4650">#4560</a>).</li> <li>Resolve Bootstrap responsive classes in tables (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/2997">#2997</a>).</li> <li>Fine tuning of the appearance of computational and markdown table and more uniformly apply such styling.</li> <li>Fine tuning of the appearance of header and body text.</li> <li>Fix invalid figcaption DOM structure (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/5234">#5234</a>).</li> </ul> <h5 id="article-layout-2">Article Layout</h5> <ul> <li>Improve positioning of margin content defined within tabsets (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3280">#3280</a>).</li> <li>Improve support for tables with margin positioned endnotes (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4324">#4324</a>).</li> </ul> <h5 id="revealjs-format-2">Revealjs Format</h5> <ul> <li>reduce font size of <code>df-print: paged</code> tables (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3380">#3380</a>)</li> <li><code>width</code> and <code>height</code> in percent are now correctly supported (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4063">#4063</a>)</li> <li>add better margins to numbered lists in the presence of many items and <code>.scrollable</code> (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4063">#4283</a>).</li> <li>Properly support scss imports for RevealJS extensions (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3414">#3414</a>)</li> <li>Authors on the title slides now correctly object customization of the <code>$presentation-title-slide-text-align</code> scss variable (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3843">#3843</a>)</li> <li>Properly support <code>show-notes: separate-page</code> <a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3996">#3996</a></li> <li>Improve footnote / aside layout for centered slides. <a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4297">#4297</a></li> <li>Ensure anchors refer to the containing slide in case of crossrefs (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4297">#3533</a>).</li> <li>Support <code>output-location</code> as a top level option in Revealjs presentations (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3261">#3261</a>)</li> <li>Fix PDF export keyboard shortcut and button in menu (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/2988">#2988</a>)</li> <li>Fix title slide CSS when <code>hash-type: number</code> (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4418">#4418</a>).</li> </ul> <h5 id="epub-format-1">EPUB Format</h5> <ul> <li>Enable webtex (epub2 format) or mathml (epub/epub3 format) by default for EPUB output <a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4403">#4403</a></li> </ul> <h5 id="dates">Dates</h5> <ul> <li>Properly fall back to language only locale when a supported language-region locale isn’t available. (#3059)</li> </ul> <h5 id="pdf-format-2">PDF Format</h5> <ul> <li>Fix wrong page number in the TOC for appendices (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3164">#3164</a>) (Thank you, <span class="citation" data-cites="iusgit">@iusgit</span>!)</li> <li>Add support for automatically converting SVG images to PDF (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/2575">#2575</a>)</li> <li>Previously, if the <code>pdf-engine</code> was set to <code>latexmk</code>, we would bypass many features of Quarto and use Pandoc to produce the PDF output. Starting in in Quarto 1.3, all Quarto features will be enabled for the <code>latexmk</code> engine and <code>latexmk</code> will be used to run the PDF generation loop.</li> <li>Fix author processing in default PDFs for complex author names (#3483)</li> <li>Remove excessive vertical space between theorem type blocks (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3776">#3776</a>).</li> <li>Fix temporary <code>.tex</code> filenames in the presence of multiple variants (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3762">#3762</a>). <ul> <li>Note that this fix changes the filenames used for PDF files with variants. In quarto 1.3, the automatic output names for PDF files include format variants and modifiers.</li> </ul></li> <li>Correctly download online image on Windows (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3982">#3982</a>).</li> <li>Permissions of <code>.tex</code> file are now correct when <code>keep-tex: true</code> (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4380">#4380</a>).</li> <li>Better support footnotes within Callouts in PDF / LaTeX output (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/1235">#1235</a>).</li> <li>Allow <code>fig-pos: false</code> to support custom figure environments that don’t support the <code>H</code> option (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/discussions/4832">#4832</a>).</li> <li>Allow <code>fig-pos:</code> to specify complex arguments with square and curly braces (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/discussions/4854">#4854</a>).</li> </ul> <h5 id="beamer-format">Beamer Format</h5> <ul> <li>Document <code>theme</code> format metadata option (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3377">#3377</a>)</li> </ul> <h5 id="markdown-formats-1">Markdown Formats</h5> <ul> <li>Properly forward variants (e.g. <code>+yaml_metadata_block</code>) to <code>gfm</code> format.</li> <li><code>gfm</code> format now supports a local browser based preview when using <code>quarto preview</code>. If you’d like to see the raw markdown in preview, you can add <code>preview-mode: raw</code> to your document front matter or project.</li> <li><code>gfm</code> and <code>commonmark</code> output formats now use ATX style headers (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4280">#4280</a>)</li> </ul> <h5 id="mermaid-diagrams-1">Mermaid diagrams</h5> <ul> <li>Upgrade to mermaid 9.2.2</li> <li>Add support for theming mermaid diagrams in Javascript formats (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/2165">#2165</a>). See the <a href="https://quarto.org/docs/prerelease/1.3.html">prerelease documentation notes</a> for details.</li> <li>Allow <code>%%| label</code> mermaid cell option that control the <code>id</code> of the resulting SVG, to facilitate CSS overrides.</li> <li>Use <code>htmlLabels: false</code> in mermaid flowcharts.</li> <li>Remove support for tooltips, which appear to not be working in mermaid 9.2.2.</li> <li>Add support for <code>fig-align</code> in mermaid diagrams in HTML format (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3294">#3294</a>).</li> <li>Add support for <code>%%| file</code> mermaid cell option (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3665">#3665</a>).</li> <li>Fix <code>code-fold</code> support in mermaid (and dot) diagrams (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4423">#4423</a>).</li> <li>Fix caption insertion in the presence of alignment specifiers with <code>{}</code> in them (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4748">#4748</a>).</li> <li>Support <code>fig-env</code> and <code>fig-pos</code> in mermaid diagrams in PDF format (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/discussions/4832">#4832</a>).</li> </ul> <h5 id="dot-diagrams">Dot diagrams</h5> <ul> <li>Support <code>fig-env</code> and <code>fig-pos</code> in dot diagrams in PDF format (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/discussions/4832">#4832</a>).</li> </ul> <h5 id="dates-1">Dates</h5> <ul> <li>Properly fall back to language only locale when a supported language-region locale isn’t available. (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3059">#3059</a>)</li> </ul> <h5 id="about-pages">About Pages</h5> <ul> <li>Add support for <code>image-alt</code> which provides alternate text for the about page image. (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3010">#3010</a>)</li> <li>Add support for <code>image-title</code> on About pages (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3077">#3077</a>)</li> </ul> <h5 id="article-layout-3">Article Layout</h5> <ul> <li>Improve the performance of extremely large documents with margin elements by improving the efficiency of positioning the elements.</li> </ul> <h5 id="listings-1">Listings</h5> <ul> <li>Listings now support <code>template-params</code>, which will be passed to custom EJS templates in a variable called <code>templateParams</code> when a listing is rendered.</li> <li>Custom listing objects now resolve <code>path:</code> fields into the metadata that would be generated by standard listings, giving custom listing access to computed metadata like <code>reading-time</code>, etc.</li> <li>Improve support for <code>date-modified</code> in listings</li> <li>Improve support for <code>yml</code> based listings by supporting usage of title and description from <code>yml</code>.</li> <li>Allow listings in project to point directly to non-input files (such as <code>yml</code> files) to use for contents.</li> <li>Allow <code>sort: false</code> to disable any sorting, allowing items to appear in their original / natural order. (#3296)</li> <li>Warn if listings are being used outside of a website (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4267">#4267</a>)</li> <li>Permit using computation outputs (plots/figures) as the preview image for an item in a listing (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/2324">#2324</a>)</li> <li>Use alt text from preview image that is discovered for a page in a listing (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3706">#3706</a>)</li> <li>Add support for <code>includes:</code> and <code>excludes:</code> in listings, which will use filter the items included in a listing. (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/2577">#2577</a>).</li> <li>Properly render structured author names in listings (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4881">#4881</a>)</li> </ul> <h5 id="websites-2">Websites</h5> <ul> <li>Add suport for ‘Back to top’ navigational button. Controlled using <code>back-to-top-navigation:</code> under <code>website:</code>, can be disabled by setting <code>back-to-top-navigation: false</code> on individual pages.</li> <li>Fix issue assigning specific sidebar to a specific page using <code>sidebar:</code> (#3389)</li> <li>Change behavior of <code>publish gh-pages</code> to always render into a clean directory. Previous behavior was to add to existing contents of <code>gh-pages</code> branch. (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/discussions/3199">#3199</a>, <span class="citation" data-cites="ijlyttle">@ijlyttle</span>)</li> <li>Order sidebar entries using filename rather than title</li> <li>Position <code>repo-actions</code> in the page footer if there is nowhere else to position them (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3998">#3998</a>)</li> <li>Render <code>page-footer</code> even when a Navbar isn’t present (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4053">#4053</a>)</li> <li>Don’t treat links with no <code>href</code> as external when <code>link-external-icon</code> is enabled (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3645">#3645</a>)</li> <li>Escape HTML from code cells that appears inline in search results (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4404">#4404</a>)</li> <li>Use input last modified timestamp when updating sitemap (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3251">#3251</a>)</li> <li>Add support for overriding the url used to report an issue with a website using <code>issue-url</code> (which can be provided even if there is no repo provided for the website).</li> <li>Properly localize search button title and various toggle aria-labels (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4559">#4559</a>)</li> <li>Support <code>navbar: true</code> to turn on a top navbar even if there are no contents</li> <li>Improve title recognition for pages that don’t include a title in metadata (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4528">#4528</a>)</li> <li>Ensure that footnote are properly indexed for website and book searches (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4601">#4601</a>).</li> <li>Permit sidebar items to include icons (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3830">#3830</a>).</li> <li>Improve the appearance of the collapsed navbar toggle button</li> <li>Properly respect the footer border when set explicitly in <code>_quarto.yml</code> (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4982">#4982</a>)</li> </ul> <h5 id="books-3">Books</h5> <ul> <li>Remove chapter number of HTML head title when <code>number-sections</code> is <code>false</code> (#3304).</li> <li>Non-HTML book output formats will now be placed in subdirectories (<code>book-<format></code>) within the project output directory (<code>_books</code>)</li> <li>Don’t discard the first chapter header when a chapter title is declared using YAML.</li> <li>Support for rendering to Asciidoc</li> <li>Support for rendering to LaTeX</li> <li>Properly support localized appendix name in book website navigation (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4578">#4578</a>)</li> <li>Don’t emit duplicate bibliography heading when LaTeX/PDF books are rendering using <code>natbib</code> or <code>biblatex</code> (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/2770">#2770</a>)</li> </ul> <h5 id="preview-4">Preview</h5> <ul> <li>Correct redirect for VS Code Server (#3352) (Thank you, <span class="citation" data-cites="benz0li">@benz0li</span>!)</li> </ul> <h5 id="lua">LUA</h5> <ul> id="html-output-1">HTML Output</h5> <ul> <li>HTML output will not decorate links within source code (for example, from <code>code-link: true</code>) with external icons. (#3755)</li> <li>Use <code>toc-expand</code> to control to what level the TOC will expand by default in HTML documents.</li> <li>Improve tab border coloring across themes (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4868">#4868</a>).</li> </ul> <h5 id="miscellaneous-2">Miscellaneous</h5> <ul> <li>Work around pandoc strict checking of <code>number-offset</code> type. (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3126">#3126</a>)</li> <li>Warn instead of crash on bad URI (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3220">#3220</a>)</li> <li>ensure <code>video</code> shortcode works with <code>embed-resources</code> and <code>self-contained</code> (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3310">#3310</a>)</li> <li>Add optional <code>rel</code> attribute to navigation links (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3212">#3212</a>)</li> <li>Use the right port when CRI is initialized multiple times (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3066">#3066</a>)</li> <li>Allow custom themes for giscus (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3105">#3105</a>)</li> <li>Add new <code>kbd</code> shortcode, to describe keyboard keys (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3384">#3384</a>). href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/2573">#2573</a>).</li> <li>Improve parsing of include shortcodes (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3159">#3159</a>).</li> <li>Add support for Youtube privacy-enhanced urls in <code>video</code> shortcodes (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4060">#4060</a>).</li> <li>Don’t emit empty cells (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4034">#4034</a>).</li> <li>Resolve link tags correctly in html dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/discussions/4304">#4304</a>) (Thank you, <span class="citation" data-cites="jdlom">@jdlom</span>!).</li> <li>use correct language code for Korean (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4352">#4352</a>).</li> <li>Only open “safe ports” for Chromium (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4514">#4514</a>).</li> <li>Detect potential bad argument ordering in <code>quarto render</code> (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3581">#3581</a>).</li> <li>Detect potential git merge conflict in parsing issue (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4573">#4573</a>).</li> <li>Use “iso” date form instead of “short” to format citations properly (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4586">#4586</a>).</li> <li>Fix typo <code>thumnail-image</code> -> <code>thumbnail-image</code> in listing template (#4602) (Thank you, <span class="citation" data-cites="mattspence">@mattspence</span>!).</li> <li>Add support for targeting the <code>#refs</code> divs with citations when using <code>natbib</code> or <code>biblatex</code> to generate a bibliography.</li> <li>Warn users about Chromium installation issues in WSL (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4586">#4596</a>).</li> <li>Fix issue with “No inspectable targets” with Chrome Browser (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4653">#4653</a>)</li> <li>Add <code>title</code> attribute for callouts (can be used rather than href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4350">#4350</a>).</li> <li>Fix issue with TeX Live 2023 bin paths on Windows (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4906">#4906</a>).</li> </ul> <h5 id="pandoc-filter-changes">Pandoc filter changes</h5> <ul> <li>Quarto 1.3 introduces the notion of Custom AST nodes to Pandoc filters. If you use Lua filters for processing callouts, tabsets, or conditional blocks, consult the <a href="https://quarto.org/docs/prerelease/1.3.html">pre-release documentation</a> for how to change your filters to support the new syntax.</li> <li>Quarto 1.3 now processes HTML tables (in Markdown input) into Pandoc AST nodes, which can be processed by user filters and output into non-HTML formats. In addition, it supports “embedded Markdown content” which will be resolved by quarto’s processing, including shortcode and crossref resolution. See the <a href="https://quarto.org/docs/prerelease/1.3.html">prerelease documentation</a> for more.</li> </ul> <h5 id="project">Project</h5> <ul> <li>fix rendering of individual project files to stdout (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4052">#4052</a>).</li> <li>fix previewing docusaurus project on Windows (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4312">#4312</a>).</li> <li>fix performance issue in large projects (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/5002">#5002</a>).</li> </ul> <h5 id="publishing-3">Publishing</h5> <ul> <li>Fix error publishing when an <code>output-dir</code> is specified (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4158">#4158</a>).</li> <li>Emit error when git <2.17.0 is used (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4575">#4575</a>).</li> <li>Fix error regarding <code>--site-url</code> when publishing document and not website (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4384">#4384</a>).</li> </ul> <h5 id="other">Other</h5> <ul> <li>Fix error when running the command <code>quarto render -h</code> to receive help (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3202">#3202</a>).</li> <li>Fix error when rendering a document with an extension which provides a directory as <code>format-resources</code> (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4377">#4377</a>).</li> <li>Fix incorrect copying of resource files during rendering (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4544">#4544</a>)</li> <li>Extension authors may now force files to be included in their template by writing the file / file path in the <code>.quartoignore</code> file prefixed with a <code>!</code>. For example <code>!README.md</code> (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4061">#4061</a>).</li> <li>Fix issue when installing extensions on older Windows (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4203">#4203</a>).</li> </ul> <h3 id="release-notes-7">1.4 Release Notes</h3> <h4 id="release-notes-8">1.4 Release Notes</h4> <h5 id="fixed-in-this-release-1">Fixed in this release</h5> <ul> <li>Update Pandoc to 3.1.12.3 to remove exposure to <code>polyfill.io</code> in Pandoc’s built-in templates.</li> </ul> <h5 id="fixed-in-previous-releases-1">Fixed in previous releases</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/8969">#8969</a>): Replace <code>polyfill.io</code> with in layouts.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10091">#10091</a>): Fix a regression with <code>fig-align</code> attributes in captionless images in PDF format.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/8439">#8439</a>): ensure that lack of subject line is handled</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/8417">#8417</a>): Maintain a single AST element in the output cell when parsing HTML from RawBlock</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/8490">#8490</a>): Properly embed <code>qmd</code> cells even when they include an explicit <code>echo</code> declaration.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/8464">#8464</a>): Fix a regression where shortcodes were not being expanded recursively.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/8485">#8485</a>): Fix a regression where shortcodes could not Unicode characters with code points above 127.</li> <li>(<a configuration.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/8514">#8514</a>): Fix a regression where crossreferences in <code>number-sections: false</code> documents were being property will no longer be used as a global sidebar. </ul> <h5 id="author-and-affiliations">Author and Affiliations</h5> <ul> <li>Add support for specifying author <code>roles</code>, with optional support for degree of contribution and automatic normalization of CreDiT roles, when applicable.</li> <li>Improved support for affiliation metadata, including <code>ringgold</code>, <code>isni</code>, <code>ror</code></li> <li>Add support for <code>recipient</code> may -be one or more simple strings, <code>ref</code>s to an author or affiliation id, or an object following the <code>institution</code> schema.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/5764">#5764</a>): Add support for affiliations to include a <code>group</code> property to represent the team or research group within the id="release-notes-9">1.5 Release Notes</h3> <h4 id="release-notes-10">1.5 Release Notes</h4> <h4 id="v1.6-backports">v1.6 backports</h4> <h5 id="in-this-release">in this release</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/9821">#9821</a>): Handle callout with empty contents in <code>revealjs</code> format properly.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10573">#10573</a>), (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10626">#10626</a>): Change command-line arguments to Chrome in remote rendering to avoid crashes with latest version.</li> </ul> <h5 id="in-previous-releases">in previous releases</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10039">#10039</a>): <code>quarto inspect</code> properly handles <code>!expr</code> tag in metadata.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10188">#10188</a>): <code>quarto inspect</code> properly resolves includes across subdirectory boundaries.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10196">#10196</a>): protect against nil values in <code>float.caption_long</code>.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10295">#10295</a>): Fix regression to return error status to shell when <code>CommandError</code> is thrown.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10358">#10358</a>): Fix regression with captioned floats where <code>caption_long</code> field might not exist.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10395">#10395</a>): Fix issue with <code>quarto publish accounts</code> from Cliffy version upgrade.</li> </ul> <h4 id="v1.5-changes">v1.5 changes</h4> <h5 id="html-format-4">HTML Format</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3178">#3178</a>): TOC now correctly expands when web page has no content to scroll to.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/6992">#6992</a>): Properly render custom license URLs in HTML page appendix,</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/8118">#8118</a>): Add support for <code>body-classes</code> to add classes to the document body.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/8311">#8311</a>): Correct z-order for margins with no contents</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/8990">#8990</a>): Copy button now works for embedded code source in modal window when optin-in <code>code-tools</code> feature.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/9076">#9076</a>): Fix issue with <code>layout-ncol</code> and <code>column</code> settings in executable code cells.</li> <li>(<a language headers).</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/9539">#9539</a>): Improve SCSS of title blocks to avoid overwide columns in grid layout.</li> <li>Improve href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/9734">#9734</a>): Fix issue with unlabeled tables and <code>tbl-cap-location</code> information.</li> </ul> <h5 id="pdf-format-4">PDF Format</h5> value box background colors.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/9492">#9492</a>): Improve performance of <code>quarto preview</code> when serving resource files of the following formats: HTML, PDF, DOCX, and plaintext.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/9496">#9496</a>): Improve parsing error message from <code>js-yaml</code> when <code>key:value</code> is used together with <code>key: value</code> in the same YAML block.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/9527">#9527</a>): Add <code>quarto.format</code> and <code>quarto.format.typst</code> to Quarto’s public Lua filter API.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/9547">#9547</a>): Fix issue with <code>quarto preview</code> and resources found in URLs with hash and search fragments.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/9550">#9550</a>): Don’t crash when subcaptions are incorrectly specified with <code>fig-subcap: true</code> but no embedded subcaptions.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/9652">#9652</a>): Allow <code>--output-dir</code> to refer to absolute paths in <code>quarto render</code>.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/9701">#9701</a>): Fix issue with callouts with non-empty titles that have no string content.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/9724">#9724</a>): Force-align text in floats of type <code>Listing</code> to the left.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/9727">#9727</a>): <code>lightbox</code>: do not overwrite <code>window.onload</code> events.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/9798">#9792</a>): Fix a 1.5 regression where <code>freeze</code> would be accidentally triggered in single-file renders.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10003">#10003</a>): fix Giscus light/dark theme YAML example in schema where <code>theme</code> is missing.</li> <li>Add support for <code>{{< lipsum >}}</code> shortcode, which is useful for emitting placeholder text. Provide a specific number of paragraphs (<code>{{< lipsum 3 >}}</code>).</li> <li>Resolve data URIs in Pandoc’s mediabag when rendering documents.</li> <li>Increase v8’s max heap size by default, to avoid out-of-memory errors when rendering large documents (also cf. <a href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/18935">github.com</a>).</li> <li>When running <code>quarto check</code> from a development build (from a git repository), show the git commit hash in addition to the version string.</li> <li>Upgrade Deno to 1.41.0</li> <li><code>quarto install tinytex</code> will now try to set the default CTAN repository to the nearest mirror resolved from <a href="https://mirror.ctan.org">mirror.ctan.org</a>.</li> <li><code>quarto render --to native</code> now works without triggering rmarkdown error about non HTML output when HTML dependencies are present in the knitr engine cell results.</li> <li>Missing <code>tabsets</code> configuration for HTML documents has now been added in the YAML schema for validation and autocompletion. This boolean value controls the inclusion of tabsets in the document (e.g when <code>minimal: true</code> is set).</li> </ul> <h5 id="languages-2">Languages</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10141">#10141</a>): Swiss German translation for Quarto UI text (credit: <span class="citation" data-cites="rastrau">@rastrau</span>)</li> </ul> <h3 id="release-notes-11">1.6 Release Notes</h3> <h4 id="release-notes-12">1.6 Release Notes</h4> <h4 id="v1.7-backports">v1.7 backports</h4> <h5 id="in-this-release-1">In this release</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12147">#12147</a>): <code>serif</code> and <code>simple</code> themes defaults back to have their heading color (<code>\$presentation-heading-color</code>) to be the same as the body color (<code>\$body-color</code>) as in Quarto 1.5.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/11659">#11659</a>): Julia engine: Fix escaping bug where paths containing spaces or backslashes break server startup on Windows.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12042">#12042</a>): Preserve Markdown content that follows YAML metadata in a <code>raw</code> .ipynb cell.</li> </ul> <h5 id="in-previous-releases-1">In previous releases</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12148">#12148</a>): Don’t import libraries outside of <code>core/lib</code> into <code>core/lib</code>, to avoid pulling in Deno-specific requirements into browser environments.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11561">#11561</a>): Fix a regression with <code>\$border-color</code> that impacted, callouts borders, tabset borders, and table borders of the defaults themes. <code>\$border-color</code> is now correctly a mixed of <code>\$body-color</code> and <code>\$body-bg</code> even for the default theme.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11943">#11943</a>): Fix callout title color on dark theme in revealjs following Revealjs update in quarto 1.6.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10532">#10532</a>): Quarto changed default of <code>--headless=old</code> to <code>--headless</code> as <a href="https://developer.chrome.com/blog/removing-headless-old-from-chrome">Chrome 132 has removed old headless mode</a> and only support new mode. For using old mode, <code>QUARTO_CHROMIUM</code> could be set to a <a href="https://developer.chrome.com/blog/chrome-headless-shell">new <code>chrome-headless-shell</code> binary</a> or too an older chrome version (between 128 and 132) and <code>QUARTO_CHROMIUM_HEADLESS_MODE</code> set to <code>old</code> for using old headless mode with that compatabitle version.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11726">#11726</a>) Typst Brand YAML: translate named CSS font weights to Typst.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11485">#11485</a>) Typst Brand YAML: fix blurry title bars of callouts by using a lightened color instead of translucent.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/11777">#11777</a>) Typst Brand YAML: make default logo smaller and bring it in a little.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/discussions/11616">#11616)</a>) Update Typst partials for <code>quarto create extension format:typst</code></li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11596">#11596</a>): Fix regression with h1 and title processing in non-website project, related to a fix for breadcrumbs in website projects (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11596">#11224</a>).</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11752">#11752</a>): Fix regression with non-alphanumeric characters in <code>categories</code> preventing correct filtering of listing.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11580">#11580</a>): Fix regression with non-string entries in the <code>categories</code> field of a listed document.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11509">#11509</a>): Fix link-decoration regression in HTML formats.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11532">#11532</a>): Fix regression for <a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/660">#660</a>, which causes files to have incorrect permissions when Quarto is installed in a location not writable by the current user.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11551">#11551</a>): Change <code>quarto create project</code> templates to better support <code>_brand.yml</code>.</li> </ul> <h4 id="v1.6-changes">v1.6 changes</h4> <h5 id="breaking-changes-1">Breaking changes</h5> <ul> <li>The syntax for standard library imports in <code>quarto run</code> TypeScript files (<code>*.ts</code>) changed. Please see <a href="https://quarto.org/docs/projects/scripts.html#deno-scripts">quarto.org</a> for how to make the necessary changes.</li> </ul> <h5 id="shortcodes-3">Shortcodes</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10292">#10292</a>): Improve shortcode passthrough when handlers are not available.</li> </ul> <h5 id="quarto-inspect-1"><code>quarto inspect</code></h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10039">#10039</a>): <code>quarto inspect</code> properly handles <code>!expr</code> tag in metadata.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10188">#10188</a>): <code>quarto inspect</code> properly resolves includes across subdirectory boundaries.</li> </ul> <h5 id="lua-filters-and-extensions">Lua Filters and extensions</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/8179">#8179</a>): When merging code cells for complex layouts, do not merge cells with different languages.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/8428">#8428</a>): only forward cell labels to tables when tables will be cross-referenceable.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10004">#10004</a>): Resolve callout titles, theorem names, and <code>code-summary</code> content through <code>quarto_ast_pipeline()</code> and <code>process_shortcodes()</code>.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10196">#10196</a>): Protect against nil values in <code>float.caption_long</code>.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10328">#10328</a>): Interpret subcells as subfloats when subcap count matches subcell count.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10624">#10624</a>): Don’t crash when proof environments are empty in <code>pdf</code>.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10858">#10858</a>): Don’t crash in <code>gfm</code> when <code>content</code> of a <code>FloatRefTarget</code> is of type <code>Blocks</code>.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10894">#10894</a>): Fix configuration of title and prefix in callouts for <code>html</code>, <code>revealjs</code>, <code>pdf</code>, and <code>typst</code>.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10999">#10999</a>): New API entry point: <code>quarto.paths.rscript()</code> to resolve <code>Rscript</code> path in Lua filters and extensions consistently with Quarto itself.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/11124">#11124</a>): Sort keys when encoding tables as JSON.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11303">#11303</a>): Fix conditional content for divs with repeated attributes.</li> </ul> <h5 id="dashboard-format"><code>dashboard</code> Format</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/9411">#9411</a>): Fix issue with history navigation in dashboards and external links.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10340">#10340</a>): Build card title correctly in the presence of equations and other markup.</li> </ul> <h5 id="html-format-5"><code>html</code> Format</h5> <ul> <li>Fix <code>kbd</code> element styling on dark themes.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10761">#10761</a>): Add support for <code>licence: CC0</code> to automatically link to Creative Commons licence <a href="https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/">CC0 1.0</a>.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10817">#10817</a>): Ensure that user provided SCSS has precedent over quarto generated scss also for dark theme.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/11124">#11124</a>): Use stable order of GLightbox options</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11401">#11401</a>): Use EJS comment syntax to hide internal TODO notes from the output.</li> </ul> <h5 id="revealjs-format-5"><code>revealjs</code> Format</h5> <ul> <li>Update to Reveal JS 5.1.0. <ul> <li>Support for a <a href="https://revealjs.com/jump-to-slide/">Jump To Slide</a> menu to quickly navigate between slides. Set <code>jump-to-slide: false</code> to opt out.</li> <li>Support for new <a href="https://revealjs.com/scroll-view/">Scroll View</a> mode with configuration through new <code>scroll-view</code> revealjs’s format configuration key. A new menu tool has been added to toggle scroll view mode on and off, associated with <code>R</code> key by default.</li> </ul></li> <li>Styles improvements for Callouts in Revealjs: <ul> <li>SCSS variables can be used to customize the appearance of callouts in Revealjs. The following SCSS variables are available: <ul> <li>Border width and scale (<code>\$callout-border-width</code>, <code>\$callout-border-scale</code>)</li> <li>Border colors (<code>\$callout-color-note</code>, <code>\$callout-color-tip</code>, <code>\$callout-color-important</code>, <code>\$callout-color-caution</code>, <code>\$callout-color-warning</code>)</li> <li>Margins (<code>\$callout-margin-top</code>, <code>\$callout-margin-bottom</code>)</li> </ul></li> <li>Color for each callout type is now the same as in Bootstrap document <code>format: html</code>. This allows for consistent styling across formats. If you prefer other colors, you can override using the new SCSS variables</li> <li>Icon for each callout type is now using SVG like in Bootstrap document <code>format: html</code>. This allows for consistent styling across formats.</li> <li>Callouts looks better in slides made smaller and when containing code blocks.</li> <li>To see how callouts looks like in revealjs, see this example: <a href="https://examples.quarto.pub/revealjs-default-callouts-styles">examples.quarto.pub</a></li> </ul></li> <li>Prevent empty SASS built css file to be included in header.</li> <li>Remove wrong <code>sourceMappingUrl</code> entry in SASS built css.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/7715">#7715</a>): Revealjs don’t support anymore special Pandoc syntax making BulletList in Blockquotes become incremental list. This was confusing and unexpected behavior. Supported syntax for incremental list is documented at <a href="https://quarto.org/docs/presentations/revealjs/#incremental-lists">quarto.org</a>.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/9742">#9742</a>): Links to cross-referenced images correctly works.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/9558">#9558</a>): To prevent default footer to show on slide, set <code>footer='false'</code> attribute on the slide header, e.g. <code>## Slide with no footer {footer='false'}</code></li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/6012">#6012</a>): Add styling for <code>kbd</code> element in Revealjs slides.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10887">#10887</a>): Updating default Mathjax used from 2.7.0 to 2.7.9.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/9999">#9999</a>): Fix spacing problems of different size elements in columns.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11146">#11146</a>): Fix issue with slide created with <code>---</code> and having no title showing up in TOC. Now they don’t show up as slide created with empty header e.g. <code>##</code>.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/7142">#7142</a>): Fix issue in slides with <code>incremental: true</code> not working as expected when <code>code-annotation: hover</code> or <code>code-annotation: select</code>.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/9803">#9803</a>): Using url for <code>logo</code> to an online svg is now working correctly with <code>embed-resources: true</code>.</li> </ul> <h5 id="typst-format"><code>typst</code> Format</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10168">#10168</a>): Support <code>csl</code> bibliography style.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10181">#10181</a>): Remove workaround for image dimensions which is no longer necessary and mishandled image paths with spaces.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10217">#10217</a>): Explicitly compute units for image dimensions in <code>typst</code> format when they’re not given.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10212">#10212</a>): Move Pandoc variables to the function declaration for the default template.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10438">#10438</a>): Ensure Pandoc doesn’t emit its own crossref environments for table elements.</li> </ul> <h5 id="docx-format-2"><code>docx</code> Format</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10401">#10401</a>): Fix crash when <code>docx</code> format is used with an empty crossref environment.</li> </ul> <h5 id="latex-and-pdf-format"><code>latex</code> and <code>pdf</code> Format</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10001">#10001</a>): Support correct <code>*-pos</code> attribute in <code>FloatRefTarget</code> nodes with layouts.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10291">#10291</a>): Several improvement regarding Quarto LaTeX engine behavior for missing hyphenation log message: <ul> <li><code>latex-auto-install: false</code> now correctly opt out any missing hyphenation packages detection and installation. Only a warning will be thrown if any detected in the log.</li> <li>For default behavior (<code>latex-auto-install: true</code>), detection is still happening and missing packages are installed automatically. If it fails, Quarto does not fail anymore as PDF rendering as succeeded already. Only a warning will be thrown to log the installation failure.</li> <li>Log message about hyphenation package missing for <code>chinese</code> or <code>chinese-hans</code> languages are now ignored.</li> </ul></li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10655">#10655</a>): Missing fonts from fontspec error are correctly detected and looked for to be installed.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10816">#10816</a>): Warn instead of crash when missing fields in custom crossreference declarations.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10891">#10891</a>): Interpret ANSI color codes in otherwise unformatted code blocks in <code>pdf</code> format.</li> </ul> <h5 id="projects-2">Projects</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/7988">#7988</a>): Do not allow <code>lib-dir</code> to cause an accidental cleanup of the project directory when its value points to a parent of the project directory.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10125">#10125</a>): Show path to the project when project YAML validation fails.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10268">#10268</a>): <code>quarto create</code> supports opening project in Positron, in addition to VS Code and RStudio IDE.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10285">#10285</a>): Include text from before the first chapter sections in search indices. In addition, include text of every element with <code>.quarto-include-in-search-index</code> class in search indices.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10566">#10566</a>): Ensure that <code>quarto run</code> outputs <code>stdout</code> and <code>stderr</code> to the correct streams.</li> </ul> <h6 id="websites-4">Websites</h6> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/2671">#2671</a>): Ensure that <code>--output-dir</code> works across filesystem boundaries.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/8571">#8517</a>), (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10829">#10829</a>): Allow listing categories with href="https://github.com/quarto-ext/manuscript-template-rstudio/issues/3">quarto-ext/manuscript-template-rstudio#3</a>).</li> </ul> <h5 id="engines-1">Engines</h5> <h6 id="julia-2"><code>julia</code></h6> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10225">#10225</a>): Handle API change in <code>is_manifest_current</code> in Julia 1.11.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11013">#11013</a>): Fix QuartoNotebookRunner.jl precompilation failure on Julia 1.11.</li> </ul> <h6 id="jupyter-7"><code>jupyter</code></h6> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/9134">#9134</a>): Add proper fix for <code>multiprocessing</code> in notebooks with the </ul> <h5 id="chromium-support">Chromium support</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11135">#11135</a>): Use <code>--headless=old</code> mode for Chromium to avoid recent issues with the new <code>--headless</code> mode. Setting <code>--headless=new</code> can be configured with <code>QUARTO_CHROMIUM_HEADLESS_MODE=new</code> environment variable, however it is not recommended new headless mode seems to be unstable. Only use to be unblocked of a situation (like <code>QUARTO_CHROMIUM_HEADLESS_MODE="none"</code> if you use an old chrome version somehow that don’t support <code>--headless=old</code>).</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10170">#10170</a>): Quarto should find chrome executable automatically on most OS. If this is does not find it, or a specific version is needed, set <code>QUARTO_CHROMIUM</code> environment variable to the executable path.</li> <li>Quarto now makes sure that all started chromium instances are closed when the process ends, no matter how it ends (success, error, or interruption).</li> </ul> <h5 id="other-fixes-and-improvements-2">Other Fixes and Improvements</h5> <ul> <li>Upgrade <code>mermaidjs</code> to 11.2.0.</li> <li>Upgrade Pandoc to 3.4.</li> <li>Upgrade <code>deno</code> to 1.46.3.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/2699">#2699</a>): Respect input/output streams in <code>quarto pandoc</code>.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10162">#10162</a>): Use Edge on <code>macOS</code> as a Chromium browser when available.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10235">#10235</a>): Configure the CI schedule trigger to activate exclusively for the upstream repository.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10235">#10295</a>): Fix regression to return error status to shell when <code>CommandError</code> is thrown.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10332">#10332</a>): Use <code>exitWithCleanup</code> whenever possible instead of <code>Deno.exit</code> to clean up temporary resources.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10334">#10334</a>): Fix <code>author</code> field rendered incorrectly in dashboards when multiple authors are present.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/8383">#8383</a>), (<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10087">#10087</a>), (<a href="https://github.coma/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10369">#10369</a>): Track theme generation and file naming through content hashing to allow different themes to coexist in the same project.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10442">#10442</a>): Honor the <code>semver</code> requirement in <code>QUARTO_VERSION_REQUIREMENT</code> and stop execution when that isn’t met.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10552">#10552</a>): Add <code>contents</code> shortcode.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10581">#10581</a>): Add <code>.landscape</code> div processing to <code>typst</code>, <code>docx</code> and <code>pdf</code> formats to support pages in landscape orientation.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10591">#10591</a>): Make fenced div syntax slightly more robust by removing spaces around the <code>=</code> sign ahead of Pandoc’s reader.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10608">#10608</a>): Don’t overwrite the built-in CSS function <code>contrast</code> in Quarto’s SCSS.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10622">#10622</a>): Use copy+remove instead of move when needed to support temporary directories in different filesystems.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10821">#10821</a>): Be more conservative in stripping <code>echo: fenced</code> from fenced output.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10890">#10890</a>): Don’t use ports that Firefox considers unsafe.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10936">#10936</a>): Use <code>\\</code> in <code>meta</code> shortcode to escape the following character, allowing keys with <code>.</code> in them.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11068">#11068</a>): use standard location when writing to standard output to avoid breakage under <code>self-contained: true</code>.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/11155">#11155</a>): Add cache location information to <code>quarto check</code>.</li> </ul> <h6 id="languages-3">Languages</h6> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/11246">#11246</a>): Basque translation for Quarto UI text (credit: <span class="citation" data-cites="iagobaapellaniz">@iagobaapellaniz</span>)</li> </ul> <h3 id="release-notes-13">1.7 Release Notes</h3> <h4 id="release-notes-14">1.7 Release Notes</h4> <h4 id="v1.8-backports">v1.8 backports</h4> <h5 id="in-this-release-2">In this release</h5> <h5 id="in-previous-releases-2">In previous releases</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/6607">#6607</a>): Add missing beamer template update for beamer theme options: <code>colorthemeoptions</code>, <code>fontthemeoptions</code>, <code>innerthemeoptions</code> and <code>outerthemeoptions</code>.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/12625">#12625</a>): Fire resize event on window when light/dark toggle is clicked, to tell widgets to resize.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/12657">#12657</a>): Load Giscus in generated script tag, to avoid wrong-theming in Chrome.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12700">#12700</a>): Giscus not loading on a site without dark mode configured.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12780">#12780</a>): <code>keep-ipynb: true</code> now works again correctly and intermediate <code>.quarto_ipynb</code> is not removed.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12627">#12627</a>): Don’t actually install extension when user responds <code>yes</code> to first prompt but <code>no</code> to second.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12753">#12753</a>): Support change in IPython 9+ and import <code>set_matplotlib_formats</code> from <code>matplotlib_inline.backend_inline</code> in the internal <code>setup.py</code> script used to initialize rendering with Jupyter engine.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/12870/">#12870</a>): Update QuartoNotebookRunner to 0.17.3.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/13051">#13051</a>): Fixed support for captioned Markdown table inside Div syntax for crossref. This is special handling, but this could be output by function like <code>knitr::kable()</code> with old option support.</li> </ul> <h4 id="v1.7-changes">v1.7 changes</h4> <h5 id="regression-fixes">Regression fixes</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11509">#11509</a>): Fix link-decoration regression in HTML formats.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11532">#11532</a>): Fix regression for <a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/660">#660</a>, which causes files to have incorrect permissions when Quarto is installed in a location not writable by the current user.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11549">#11549</a>): Fix regression in rendering <code>dashboard</code> tabsets into cards without titles.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11561">#11561</a>): Fix a regression with <code>\$border-color</code> that impacted, callouts borders, tabset borders, and table borders of the defaults themes. <code>\$border-color</code> is now correctly a mixed of <code>\$body-color</code> and <code>\$body-bg</code> even for the default theme.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11580">#11580</a>): Fix regression with documents containing <code>categories</code> fields that are not strings.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/11659">#11659</a>): <code>julia</code> engine - Fix escaping bug where paths containing spaces or backslashes break server startup on Windows.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11752">#11752</a>): Fix regression with non-alphanumeric characters in <code>categories</code> preventing correct filtering of listing.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11943">#11943</a>): Fix callout title color on dark theme in revealjs following Revealjs update in quarto 1.6.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11990">#11990</a>): Do not print parameter cell in parameterized Jupyter notebooks.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12147">#12147</a>): for RevealJS format, <code>serif</code> and <code>simple</code> themes defaults back to have their heading color (<code>\$presentation-heading-color</code>) to be the same as the body color (<code>\$body-color</code>) as in Quarto 1.5.</li> </ul> <h5 id="dependencies-1">Dependencies</h5> <ul> <li>Update <code>typst</code> to <code>0.13.0</code>.</li> <li>Update <code>pandoc</code> to <code>3.6.3</code>.</li> <li>Update <code>dart-sass</code> to <code>1.85.1</code>.</li> <li>Update <code>esbuild</code> to <code>0.19.12</code>.</li> </ul> <h5 id="yaml-validation">YAML validation</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10251">#10251</a>): EJS template for website now uses proper object to get alt text for logo in sidebar.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11654">#11654</a>): Allow <code>page-inset</code> as value in <code>column</code> key for code cells.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12151">#12151</a>): Fix YAML validation in computations cell on Windows. Validate YAML in documents in <code>julia</code> engine.</li> </ul> <h5 id="projects-3">Projects</h5> <h6 id="website-1"><code>website</code></h6> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/8238">#8238</a>): Listing categories are now sorted case-insensitively.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10501">#10501</a>): Improve documentation of <code>repo-actions</code> option.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11701">#11701</a>): Wrap HTML emitted by EJS templates in <code>{=html}</code> blocks to avoid memory blowup issues with Pandoc’s parser.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12134">#12134</a>): Forward <code>logo.small</code> images in <code>_brand.yml</code> files to a website <code>favicon</code>.</li> </ul> <h6 id="blog"><code>blog</code></h6> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11745">#11745</a>): Fix categories links under post title in post with url encoded path (e.g. with space or other special characters).</li> </ul> <h6 id="book-1"><code>book</code></h6> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11520">#11520</a>): Book’s cover image now escapes lightbox treatment, which was incorrectly applied to it when <code>lightbox: true</code> was set in the book’s configuration.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12134">#12134</a>): Forward <code>logo.small</code> images in <code>_brand.yml</code> files to the <code>favicon</code> of the book’s website.</li> </ul> <h5 id="commands-30">Commands</h5> <h6 id="quarto-check-1"><code>quarto check</code></h6> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10047">#10047</a>): <code>quarto check</code> will now check binary dependency versions strictly by default. Use <code>quarto check --no-strict</code> to revert to old behavior.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10561">#10561</a>): <code>quarto check</code> will now report paths of binary dependencies.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/11608">#11608</a>): Do not issue error message when calling <code>quarto check info</code>.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/12433">#12433</a>): Add <code>--output</code> option to <code>quarto check</code> to produce structured JSON output.</li> </ul> <h6 id="quarto-convert"><code>quarto convert</code></h6> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12042">#12042</a>): Preserve Markdown content that follows YAML metadata in a <code>raw</code> .ipynb cell.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12318">#12318</a>): Ensure enough line breaks between cells that might be trimmed.</li> </ul> <h6 id="quarto-inspect-2"><code>quarto inspect</code></h6> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12336">#12336</a>): Clean up transient files created by <code>quarto inspect</code>.</li> </ul> <h5 id="formats">Formats</h5> <h6 id="dashboard"><code>dashboard</code></h6> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11338">#11338</a>): Remove unused datatables imports when appropriate.</li> </ul> <h6 id="html"><code>html</code></h6> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/1325">#1325</a>): Dark Mode pages should not flash light on reload. (Nor should Light Mode pages flash dark.)</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/1470">#1470</a>): <code>respect-user-color-scheme</code> enables checking the media query <code>prefers-color-scheme</code> for user dark mode preference. Author preference still influences stylesheet order and NoJS experience. Defaults to <code>false</code>, leaving to author preference.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10780">#10780</a>): improve <code>link-external-filter</code> documentation.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11860">#11860</a>): ES6 modules that import other local JS modules in documents with <code>embed-resources: true</code> are now correctly embedded.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11911">#11911</a>): Code highlighting colors for tokens are now the same between code blocks and inline code when using Pandoc’s syntax highlighting.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12118">#12118</a>): Don’t hide <code>:focus</code> on code-copy button.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/12277">#12277</a>): Provide light and dark plot and table renderings with <code>renderings: [light,dark]</code></li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12307">#12307</a>): Tabsets using <code>tabby.js</code> in non-boostrap html (<code>theme: pandoc</code>, <code>theme: none</code> or <code>minimal: true</code>) now correctly render reactive content when <code>server: shiny</code> is used.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/12319">#12319</a>): Provide switchable light and dark brands for a page with <code>brand.light</code> and <code>brand.dark</code>.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12356">#12356</a>): Remove duplicate id in HTML document when using <code>#lst-</code> prefix label for using Quarto crossref.</li> </ul> <h6 id="pdf"><code>pdf</code></h6> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11695">#11695</a>): Translate ANSI color codes more carefully inside <code>highlighting</code> environments.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11835">#11835</a>): Take markdown structure into account when detecting minimum heading level.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11878">#11878</a>, <a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12085">#12085</a>): Correctly fixup raw LaTeX table having an unexpected table env with options (e.g <code>\begin{table}[!ht]</code>) to be handled as crossref table.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11903">#11903</a>): <code>crossref</code> configuration like <code>fig-title</code> or <code>tbl-title</code> now correctly supports multi word values, e.g. <code>fig-title: 'Supplementary Figure'</code>.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12344">#12344</a>): Ensure decorated code blocks do not float when inside layout elements.</li> <li>Update to Pandoc’s LaTeX template following Pandoc 3.6.3 support: <ul> <li><code>format: beamer</code> now uses its own template. The main template for latex does not use <code>\$if(beamer)\$</code> anymore, and the new template for beamer uses the same partials as latex one.</li> <li>Improved Babel support: <ul> <li>New <code>babeloptions</code> variable in the template to allow for more flexible Babel options.</li> <li><code>doc-class.tex</code> Quarto’s partial has been updated as Babel options have been moved to <code>documentclass</code> definition in <code>doc-class.tex</code> Quarto’s partial.</li> </ul></li> <li>New partials available for <code>format: latex</code> and <code>format: beamer</code>: <ul> <li>Pandoc now uses partials for its latex templates, and they are available through <code>template-partials</code>. Pandoc’s partials uses <code>.latex</code> extension: <code>passoptions.latex</code>, <code>common.latex</code>, <code>font-settings.latex</code>, <code>fonts.latex</code>, <code>hypersetup.latex</code>, <code>after-header-includes.latex</code></li> <li>New Quarto partials: <code>babel-lang.tex</code>, <code>biblio-config.tex</code>. Quarto’s partials uses <code>.tex</code> extension.</li> </ul></li> <li>BREAKING CHANGE for templates authors: <code>common.latex</code> does now uses <code>pandoc.tex</code> partial from Quarto, which include now part of the content that was in main <code>template.tex</code>. If you modify <code>pandoc.tex</code> as part of a custom format, it should be updated to new content.</li> </ul></li> </ul> <h6 id="jats"><code>jats</code></h6> <ul> <li>Update to Pandoc’s template following Pandoc 3.6.3 support: <ul> <li><code>article.jats_publishing</code> partials now support <code>author.roles</code></li> </ul></li> </ul> <h6 id="revealjs-1"><code>revealjs</code></h6> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12307">#12307</a>): Tabsets using <code>tabby.js</code> in Revealjs now correctly render reactive content when <code>server: shiny</code> is used.</li> </ul> <h6 id="typst-format-1"><code>typst</code> format</h6> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11578">#11578</a>): Typst column layout widths use fractional <code>fr</code> units instead of percent <code>%</code> units for unitless and default widths in order to fill the enclosing block and not spill outside it.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/11676">#11676</a>): Convert unitless image widths from pixels to inches for column layouts.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11835">#11835</a>): Take markdown structure into account when detecting minimum heading level.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11964">#11964</a>): Using panel layout without a crossref label now correctly do not add an empty <code>#block[]</code> that was leading to an unnecessary space in output.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/12387">#12387</a>): <code>brand-mode</code> chooses whether to use <code>light</code> (default) or <code>dark</code> brand yml.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11825">#12825</a>): Callouts look better with dark brands, mixing the title color and using brand background color for body.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12354">#12354</a>): CodeBlock in Listing with <code>#lst-</code> prefix are now correctly highlighted.</li> </ul> <h5 id="engines-2">Engines</h5> <h6 id="julia-3"><code>julia</code></h6> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/11803">#11803</a>): Added subcommands <code>status</code>, <code>kill</code>, <code>close [--force]</code> and <code>log</code> under the new CLI command <code>quarto call engine julia</code>.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/12121">#12121</a>): Update QuartoNotebookRunner to 0.17.0. Support for evaluating Python cells via <a href="https://github.com/JuliaPy/PythonCall.jl">PythonCall.jl</a> added. Support for notebook caching via <code>execute.cache</code> added.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/12151">#12151</a>): Basic YAML validation is now active for documents using Julia engine.</li> </ul> <h6 id="jupyter-8"><code>jupyter</code></h6> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/9089">#9089</a>): Serialize compound <code>jupyter</code> metadata into a special key-value attribute to not break Pandoc’s fenced div parsing.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10113">#10113</a>): KaTeX will now load correctly in <code>engine: jupyter</code> documents using <code>emebed-resources: true</code>.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12114">#12114</a>): <code>JUPYTERCACHE</code> environment variable from <a href="https://jupyter-cache.readthedocs.io/en/latest/using/cli.html">Jupyter cache CLI</a> is now respected by Quarto when <code>cache: true</code> is used. This environment variable allows to change the path of the cache directory.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12228">#12228</a>): <code>quarto render</code> will now fails if errors are detected at IPython display level. Setting <code>error: true</code> globally or at cell level will keep the error to show in output and not stop the rendering.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12374">#12374</a>): Detect language properly in Jupyter notebooks that lack the <code>language</code> field in their <code>kernelspec</code>s.</li> </ul> <h5 id="quarto-pdf-rendering">Quarto PDF rendering</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12194">#12194</a>): More specific checks added in log parsing to automatically find missing fonts.</li> </ul> <h5 id="shiny-1">Shiny</h5> <ul> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/12059">#12059</a>): <code>quarto preview</code> now correctly run on Windows an interactive Quarto doc with Jupyter engine and py-shiny, when using a <code>*.py</code> file as resource.</li> </ul> <h5 id="lua-filters-and-extensions-1">Lua Filters and extensions</h5> <ul> <li>Add <code>quarto.paths.tinytex_bin_dir</code> to Quarto’s Lua API. If TinyTeX is found by Quarto, this will be set to the path to the <code>bin</code> directory of the TinyTeX installation where command line tool are located (e.g., <code>pdflatex</code>, <code>tlmgr</code>, etc.). If TinyTeX is not found, this will be <code>nil</code>, meaning Quarto will use the system PATH to find the command line tools.</li> <li>Fix <code>pandoc.mediabag</code> Lua typings so autocompletions work with the Lua LSP integration.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11379">#11379</a>): Add <code>version</code> shortcode to display the current Quarto version.</li> <li>(<a href="https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/pull/11526">#11526</a>): General improvements to the style and robustness of Quarto’s Lua code.
